blocks.text: Carbohydrates qudrati taur par paye jane wale organic compounds hain. Lafz "carbohydrate" ka lafzi matlab "hydrated carbon" hai. Carbohydrates photosynthesis ki bunyadi paidawar (primary products) ke taur par bante hain: photosynthesis ke dauran jab carbon dioxide reduce hoti hai to banne wale carbohydrate molecule mein carbon, hydrogen aur oxygen 1:2:1 ki molar nisbat (ratio) mein hote hain. Un ka empirical formula C(H2O)n hai, jahan n carbon atoms ki tadaad (number) hai.
Carbohydrates ko saccharides bhi kehte hain (Latin saccharum, sugar) aur isi naam par unhen teen groups mein baanta jata hai: monosaccharides, disaccharides aur polysaccharides.
1. Monosaccharides

Monosaccharides (saada sugars) ek sugar molecule se bane hain. Yeh pani mein aasani se hal hote hain aur in mein 3 se 7 carbon atoms ho sakte hain; carbon atoms ki tadaad ki bunyad par unhen mazeed subgroups mein baanta jata hai. Pentoses aur hexoses sab se aam hain aur tamam jandaron (organisms) mein milte hain. Hexoses tawanai (energy) zakheera karne mein markazi kirdar ada karte hain: bunyadi tawanai zakheera karne wala molecule glucose hai, jis mein saat tawanai zakheera karne wale C-H bonds hain, aur us ka empirical formula C6H12O6 ya (CH2O)6 hai.

blocks.text: Monosaccharides ke isomers

Jin molecules mein atoms ki tadaad ek jaisi ho (ek hi molecular formula) magar atoms ki tarteeb mukhtalif ho (mukhtalif structural formula) woh ek doosre ke isomers hain. Glucose C6H12O6 formula wala akela monosaccharide nahin: fructose aur galactose ka molecular formula bhi yehi hai magar un ke structural formulas mukhtalif hain. Banawat aur rukh (orientation) ke yeh farq polymers banane mein aham nataij rakhte hain. Fructose mein double-bond wala oxygen aakhri carbon ki bajaye andaruni carbon (number 2) se jura hai, is liye glucose aur fructose structural isomers hain. Glucose aur galactose mein carbon number 4 par ek hydroxyl (OH) group ke rukh ka farq hai, is liye glucose aur galactose stereoisomers hain.

blocks.alt: Teen khuli-zanjeer (Fischer) formulas, unwan Aldose, Ketose, Aldose: glucose (carbon 1 par C=O), fructose (carbon 2 par C=O) aur galactose (carbon 1 par C=O). C=O groups roshan hain, aur glucose aur galactose ke carbon 4 par H aur OH, jo ulte hain, roshan hain. Labels: Aldose, Ketose, Glucose, Fructose, Galactose.
blocks.caption: Figure 4.12: Glucose ke structural aur stereoisomers (kitab ki Figure 4.12 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.text: Aam paanch-carbon (pentose) sugars mein ribose aur deoxyribose shamil hain, jo nucleic acids aur ATP mein milte hain, aur ribulose, jo photosynthesis mein ek precursor hai.

blocks.alt: Khuli-zanjeer ribose: upar H-C=O, phir H-C-OH ki ikaiyan, aur neeche H (C1 aldehyde se C5 tak).
blocks.caption: Figure 4.13: Ribose ki banawat (kitab ki Figure 4.13 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.text: Monosaccharides ki ring banawat

Mahlool (solution) mein zyada tar monosaccharides ring banawat banate hain. Ring tab banti hai jab ek hi sugar molecule ke do carbon atoms ke darmiyan oxygen bridge banta hai. Glucose mein oxygen bridge carbon 1 aur carbon 5 ke darmiyan banta hai, jis se chhe-konon wali ring (pyran) banti hai. Galactose mein bhi bridge carbons 1 aur 5 ke darmiyan banta hai, phir chhe-konon wali pyran ring. Fructose mein bridge carbons 2 aur 5 ke darmiyan banta hai, jis se paanch-konon wali ring (furan) banti hai. Jab ribose mahlool mein jata hai to bridge carbons 1 aur 4 ke darmiyan banta hai, is liye paanch-konon wali furan ring banti hai.

D-glucose ki do shaklein hain, alpha-D-glucose aur beta-D-glucose, jo sirf carbon 1 par OH group ki simt mein mukhtalif hain: alpha-D-glucose mein OH neeche ki taraf hai, beta-D-glucose mein upar ki taraf. Jab bohat se alpha-D-glucose molecules jurte hain to polymer starch banta hai; jab bohat se beta-D-glucose molecules jurte hain to polymer cellulose banta hai.

blocks.alt: Haworth rings, carbon numbers aur har H aur OH ke saath: glucose aur galactose (chhe kone wali rings, carbon 6 CH2OH; galactose mein carbon 4 ka OH upar hai), fructose aur ribose (paanch kone wali rings). Neeche: alpha-D-glucose (carbon 1 ka OH neeche) aur beta-D-glucose (carbon 1 ka OH upar), roshan.
blocks.caption: Figure 4.14: Glucose, galactose, fructose aur ribose ki ring banawat (kitab ki Figure 4.14 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Haworth ring ko aise dekhein jaise ring kaghaz se bahar ko leti hui ho: moti (bold) lakeer aap ki taraf wala kinara hai. Har carbon par ek group upar aur ek neeche hai. Glucose aur galactose mein sirf carbon 4 ka farq hai: glucose mein OH neeche, galactose mein upar. Alpha aur beta glucose mein sirf carbon 1 ka farq hai: alpha mein OH neeche, beta mein upar.

blocks.title: Fischer aur Haworth projections
blocks.text: Yeh sugar molecules ki banawat dikhane ke do tareeqe hain. Fischer projection, jo German chemist Emil Fischer ne 1891 mein banai, carbohydrate ko khuli-zanjeer shakal mein dikhati hai. Haworth projection, jo British chemist Sir Norman Haworth ke naam par hai, sugars ko un ki ring shakal mein dikhati hai.

blocks.alt: D-glucose (linear form) Fischer projection mein, carbons 1 (CHO) se 6 (CH2OH) tak numbered; do laal teer alpha-D-glucose (carbon 1 ka OH neeche) aur beta-D-glucose (carbon 1 ka OH upar) ki Haworth rings ki taraf, har ek par tamam H, OH aur carbon numbers.
blocks.caption: Glucose ki Fischer aur Haworth projections (kitab ka side box) (kitab ke side box ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.text: 2. Disaccharides

Disaccharides do monosaccharides se dehydration synthesis ke zariye bante hain. Do monosaccharides ke darmiyan covalent bond glycosidic bond hai. Hydrolysis par yeh woh monosaccharide monomers dete hain jin se bane hain. Monosaccharides ke muqable mein yeh pani mein kam hal hote hain. Jismani (physiologically) aham disaccharides maltose, lactose aur sucrose hain.

items: Maltose (malt sugar) do glucose monomers se bana hai jo ek glucose ke carbon 1 aur doosre ke carbon 4 ke darmiyan 1,4-glycosidic bond se jure hain. Yeh bohat se anaj (cereals: gandum, makai waghaira) mein milta hai aur starch ke hazme ke dauran darmiyani paidawar ke taur par bhi banta hai.

blocks.alt: Do alpha-glucose Haworth rings carbon numbers ke saath; pehli ke carbon 1 ka OH aur doosri ke carbon 4 ka HO roshan hain. Teer neeche, H2O nikalta hai, aur maltose banta hai: rings carbon 1 aur carbon 4 ke darmiyan ek O se juri hain, label 1,4-glycosidic linkage.
blocks.caption: Figure 4.15: Do glucose ke condensation se ek maltose ki dehydration synthesis (kitab ki Figure 4.15 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Pehle glucose ke carbon 1 ka OH aur doosre glucose ke carbon 4 ke OH ka H mil kar pani (H2O) ban jate hain. Baqi bacha O dono rings ko jorta hai. Kyunke yeh pul carbon 1 aur carbon 4 ko jorta hai, ise 1,4-glycosidic linkage kehte hain.

items: Lactose (doodh ki sugar) ek glucose aur ek galactose subunit se bana hai: galactose 1-4 glucose. Yeh sirf mammals ke doodh mein milta hai aur bachcha mammals ke liye tawanai ka bunyadi zariya hai.

blocks.alt: Do Haworth rings carbon numbers ke saath: galactose subunit (carbon 4 ka OH upar) jis ka carbon 1 ek O ke zariye glucose subunit ke carbon 4 se jura hai. Labels: Galactose subunit, Glucose subunit, 1,4-glycosidic linkage.
blocks.caption: Figure 4.16: Lactose ki banawat (kitab ki Figure 4.16 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

items: Sucrose (ganne ki sugar) ek glucose aur ek fructose subunit se bana hai: glucose 1-2 fructose. Yeh sab se jana-pehchana disaccharide hai, jise table sugar bhi kehte hain, aur hamare khane mein meetha karne wala hai. Yeh aala podon ki phloem naliyon mein bhi milta hai, jahan yeh poday ke mukhtalif hisson tak glucose pohanchane ka transport product hai; isi liye ise transport disaccharide bhi kehte hain.

blocks.alt: Glucose ki ring (chhe kone, carbon numbers 1 se 6) jis ka carbon 1 ek O ke zariye fructose ring (paanch kone, carbon numbers 1 se 6, carbon 1 par HOCH2) ke carbon 2 se jura hai. Labels: Glucose subunit, Fructose subunit, 1,2-glycosidic linkage.
blocks.caption: Figure 4.17: Sucrose ki banawat (kitab ki Figure 4.17 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: High-fructose corn syrup
blocks.text: 1950 tak khane ke sweeteners ganne aur chuqandar (beet) se nikale sucrose se liye jate the; market ka chhota hissa makai ke starch ko glucose mein tor kar sweeteners hasil karta tha, magar glucose sucrose se aadha meetha hai, is liye yeh koi sanjeeda muqabil na tha. 1980 ki dahai mein makai ke starch ke glucose ko us ke isomer fructose mein badalne ka tareeqa bana, jo sucrose se bhi zyada meetha hai. Yeh high-fructose corn syrup sasta hai aur bohat si tayyar khuraak mein sucrose ki jagah le chuka hai; cola soft drinks banane wale, jo kabhi duniya mein sucrose ke sab se bare tijarati sarif the, ab ise taqreeban mukammal taur par high-fructose corn syrup se badal chuke hain.
3. Polysaccharides

Polysaccharides qudrat mein sab se pecheeda (complex) aur sab se zyada paye jane wale carbohydrates hain. Yeh glycosidic bonds se jure bohat se monosaccharides ki lambi zanjeerein hain. Teen aham polysaccharides starch, glycogen aur cellulose hain.
Starch

Starch poday ka zakheera (storage) polysaccharide hai. Yeh hal nahin hota aur bohat se poday ke cells ke andar starch ke daane banata hai; hal na hone ki wajah se yeh poday ke cells ka water potential nahin badalta, is liye cells ko osmosis se pani lene par majboor nahin karta. Starch khalis madda nahin balke amylose aur amylopectin ka mila-jula hai. Amylose 1,4-glycosidic linkages wale glucose monomers ki zanjeer hai; yeh seedhi aur be-shakh hai magar kundli (helix) mein lipat jati hai. Amylopectin bhi 1,4-glycosidic linkages wale glucose monomers ki zanjeer hai, magar is mein 1,6-glycosidic linkages wali shakhein (branches) bhi hain, is liye is ke zyada sire hain jinhen amylase enzymes zyada tezi se tor sakte hain. Amylose aur amylopectin dono ko enzyme amylase maltose mein torta hai, magar mukhtalif raftar se.

blocks.alt: (a) Amylose: glucose motiyon ki ek be-shaakh zanjeer jo kundli (helix) mein lipti hai, pehlu se chhallon ki tarah dikhti hai. (b) Amylopectin: glucose motiyon ki zanjeer jis se shaakhein (branches) nikalti hain.
blocks.caption: Figure 4.18: (a) amylose, (b) amylopectin (kitab ki Figure 4.18 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.text: Glycogen

Glycogen banawat mein amylopectin jaisa hai: 1,4-glycosidic linkages wale glucose monomers ki zanjeer jis mein 1,6-glycosidic linkages wali shakhein hain. Ise janwar apne zakheera polysaccharide ke taur par banate hain aur yeh zyada tar muscles aur jigar (liver) mein milta hai. Bohat zyada shakhdar hone ki wajah se yeh bohat tezi se glucose mein tora ja sakta hai.

blocks.alt: Glucose motiyon ki zanjeer jis se bohat si shaakhein nikalti hain, aur kuch shaakhon se aur shaakhein: bohat zyada shaakh-daar molecule.
blocks.caption: Figure 4.19: Glycogen (kitab ki Figure 4.19 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.text: Cellulose

Cellulose sirf podon mein milta hai, jahan yeh cell walls ka bunyadi juz hai. Yeh 1,4-glycosidic linkages wale glucose monomers ki zanjeer hai, magar glucose ke ek mukhtalif isomer ki. Starch aur glycogen mein alpha-glucose hai, jis mein carbon 1 ka OH group ring se neeche ki taraf hai, jabke cellulose mein beta-glucose hai, jis mein carbon 1 ka OH group upar ki taraf hai. Is ka matlab hai ke cellulose mein har doosra glucose molecule ulta hai.

blocks.alt: Chaar glucose rings ki do qataarein, carbon numbers 1 se 6. Starch: tamam rings ek hi rukh, C1-O-C4 se juri; teer O pulon tak, label Alpha 1-4 glycosidic bonds in starch. Cellulose: har doosri ring ulti (carbon 6 neeche), C1-O-C4 se juri; label Beta 1-4 glycosidic bonds in cellulose.
blocks.caption: Figure 4.20: Starch aur cellulose ka farq (kitab ki Figure 4.20 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Upar starch mein har glucose ring seedhi hai (alpha glucose, carbon 1 ka OH neeche), is liye zanjeer mur kar kundli banati hai. Neeche cellulose mein beta glucose hai (carbon 1 ka OH upar), is liye jorne ke liye har doosri ring ulti ho jati hai; yeh zanjeer seedhi rehti hai aur aisi zanjeerein hydrogen bonds se jur kar mazboot resha banati hain.

Yeh bazahir nanha farq banawat aur khususiyat mein bohat bara farq paida karta hai: starch ka alpha 1-4 glucose polymer kundli ban kar daane banata hai, jabke cellulose ka beta 1-4 glucose polymer seedhi zanjeerein banata hai. Aisi sainkron zanjeerein hydrogen bonds se jur kar cellulose microfibrils banati hain, aur yeh cellulose fibrils banate hain. Yeh bohat mazboot aur sakht hain aur poday ke cells ko, aur yun naye podon aur kaghaz aur kapas (cotton) jaise maddon ko mazbooti dete hain.

blocks.alt: Poday ka cell apni cell wall ke saath; wall ka bara kiya hissa aar-paar resha dikhata hai; ek cellulose fibril silinder (cylinder) ki tarah jis ke kate sire par microfibrils hain; neeche glucose rings ki mutawazi (parallel) cellulose zanjeerein jo dashed hydrogen bonds se juri hain. Labels: Plant cell, Cell wall, Cellulose fibril, Microfibril, Cellulose chains.
blocks.caption: Figure 4.21: Poday ki cell wall mein cellulose fibrils (kitab ki Figure 4.21 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Cellulose ka hazam hona
blocks.text: Beta-glycosidic bond amylase se nahin toot sakta; ise khaas cellulase enzyme chahiye. Kuch bacteria aur kuch protozoans hi cellulase rakhne wale jandar hain. Gaay aur deemak (termites) jaise sabza-khor (herbivores), jin ki khuraak zyada tar cellulose hai, apni aant mein mutualistic bacteria rakhte hain jo un ka cellulose hazam karte hain. Insaan cellulose hazam nahin kar sakte, aur ise dietary fibre kaha jata hai.
Chitin

Chitin cellulose ki ek badli hui (modified) shakal hai, jo kekron (crabs), lobsters aur keeron (insects) ke exoskeletons mein milti hai; yeh fungi ki cell wall bhi banata hai. Cellulose ki tarah yeh bhi glucose ka polymer hai, aur glucose monomers ke darmiyan jor cellulose jaisa hai, magar chitin mein har glucose molecule ko nitrogen wala group shamil kar ke badla gaya hai. Sirf chand jandar ise hazam kar sakte hain.

blocks.alt: Chaar glucose rings O pulon se juri, cellulose ki tarah har doosri ring ulti; har ring ke carbon 2 par ghere mein nitrogen wala group NH-C(=O)-CH3. Labels: Glucose, Nitrogen-containing group.
blocks.caption: Figure 4.22: Chitin molecule ka ek hissa (kitab ki Figure 4.22 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Doosre polysaccharides
blocks.text: Pectin aur lignin bhi tameeri (building) madde ke taur par istemal hone wale polysaccharides hain; yeh poday ke cells ki cell walls mein hote hain. Agar surkh algae ki cell walls mein milta hai; yeh khuraak mein gaarha karne (thickener) ke liye aur laboratories mein bacteria aur fungi ugane ke medium ke taur par istemal hota hai. Murein sugar-peptide polymer hai jo prokaryotes ki cell walls mein milta hai.

blocks.prompt: Starch aur cellulose dono glucose ke 1-4 jure polymers hain. Samjhayen ke ek khuraak ka zakheera aur doosra tameeri madda kyun hai, aur hum ek ko hazam kar sakte hain doosre ko kyun nahin.
blocks.explanation: Starch alpha-glucose se bana hai, is liye is ki zanjeerein lipat kar compact daane banati hain jo zakheera karne mein aasan hain aur jinhen amylase maltose mein torta hai. Cellulose beta-glucose se bana hai jis mein har doosri ikai ulti hai, is liye is ki zanjeerein seedhi hain aur hydrogen bond se mazboot microfibrils banati hain jo khinchao ko rokte hain, walls ke liye behtareen. Amylase beta bond nahin kaat sakta; sirf cellulase kaat sakta hai, aur insanon ke paas yeh nahin, is liye cellulose dietary fibre ke taur par guzar jata hai.

blocks.text: Mukhtasar khulasa

items: Carbohydrates, C(H2O)n, photosynthesis ki bunyadi paidawar hain: monosaccharides, disaccharides aur polysaccharides.

Monosaccharides mein 3 se 7 carbons hain (trioses se heptoses); glucose C6H12O6 bunyadi tawanai zakheera hai. Glucose, fructose (structural isomer, carbonyl carbon 2 par) aur galactose (stereoisomer, carbon 4 par OH ulta) ek formula share karte hain. Rings: glucose aur galactose pyran (C1 se C5), fructose aur ribose furan; alpha-glucose starch banata hai, beta-glucose cellulose.
Disaccharides dehydration synthesis se glycosidic bonds ke zariye bante hain: maltose (glucose 1-4 glucose), lactose (galactose 1-4 glucose), sucrose (glucose 1-2 fructose, transport sugar).

Polysaccharides: starch (amylose be-shakh helix aur amylopectin shakhdar; amylase maltose deta hai), glycogen (bohat shakhdar janwar ka zakheera), cellulose (beta 1,4, seedhi zanjeerein, microfibrils; cellulase chahiye), chitin (nitrogen se badla cellulose); pectin, lignin, agar aur murein bhi.
